summary: Versioned public release information and reproducible distribution candidates.
changes: Public release notes are generated from one reviewed record and bound to candidate checksums.
Channel descriptions include versioned upgrade, permission, security and limitation information.
upgrade: Install buddie==2.0.2 with pip or select the matching approved plugin or Desktop bundle. Existing PyPI 2.0.1 artifacts remain unchanged.
permissions: Local checks run without a model. GitHub anchors may use optional GitHub credentials; browser access is optional and requires a separate browser installation.
security: Release candidates bind public notes and Registry payloads to the recorded source revision and file digests. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.
limitations: Checks support evidence review and do not establish that every claim is true. Catalog display of release notes is unverified; publication and plugin promotion require separate authorization.
